name: Crossmar Rentals
about: Crossmar Rentals is a heavy equipment rental company serving contractors, construction crews, and industrial clients. We offer a wide fleet of well-maintained equipment with flexible rental terms, and provide on-site mechanic support when you need it.

services.name: Equipment Rental
services.description: Short and long-term rental of excavators, bulldozers, backhoes, skid steers, forklifts, and more.

services.name: Equipment Availability
services.description: Check current inventory and availability of specific machines.

services.name: On-Site Mechanic Support
services.description: Dispatch a mechanic to your job site for equipment breakdowns and repairs.

services.name: Quote Request
services.description: Get a custom rental or service quote based on your project needs.

faqs.hours: Our office is open Monday through Friday 9 AM to 5 PM, and Saturday 9 AM to 1 PM. We are closed on Sundays. For equipment emergencies, we have an on-call mechanic available after hours.
faqs.location: We are located at 123 Main Street, Chicago, IL 60601.
faqs.parking: Free parking is available in our lot on the south side of the building.
faqs.cancellation: Rentals and appointments can be cancelled or rescheduled with at least 2 hours notice at no charge. Late cancellations may be subject to a fee.
faqs.emergency: For equipment breakdowns after hours, stay on the line and our after-hours system will connect you with the on-call mechanic.
faqs.payment: We accept cash, check, and all major credit cards. Invoicing is available for established accounts.
faqs.new_clients: New clients are always welcome. We just need some basic information to get you set up. You can call us or book an appointment online.
faqs.insurance: We are fully insured and bonded. Certificate of insurance is available upon request.
faqs.contact: You can reach us by phone at (469) 402-0936, by email at info@crossmarrentals.com, or through our website at www.crossmarrentals.com.
faqs.pricing: Rates depend on the equipment type and rental period and change frequently. Rather than give you an outdated number, I can take your name, number, and what you need — and our rental team will call you back with current pricing.
faqs.services: We offer equipment rental, availability checks, on-site mechanic support, and custom quotes. Ask us about any specific machine or service.
faqs.mechanic: We can dispatch a mechanic to your job site for breakdowns and repairs. Can you tell me what machine broke down, what the issue is, and your job site location? I'll alert our mechanic team right away.
faqs.availability: Availability changes daily based on current rentals, so I don't want to give you inaccurate information. If you let me take your name, number, and what equipment you need, our rental team will call you back with current stock and pricing.
faqs.quote: I'd be happy to get you a quote. Since rates and availability change frequently, let me take your name, number, and what equipment you're looking for — our rental team will call you back with current pricing and availability.

vapi.transfer_message: One moment, I'll connect you with the team right now.
vapi.first_message: Thank you for calling Crossmar Rentals, how can I help you today?
vapi.system_prompt:
You are Emma, the friendly and professional AI receptionist for Crossmar Rentals, a heavy equipment rental company.

Today's date and time: {{ "now" | date: "%B %d, %Y, %I:%M %p", "America/Chicago" }}

Your job is to help callers with:
- Booking, rescheduling, or cancelling rental appointments
- Answering questions about the business (hours, services, location, policies)
- Taking messages for the team when needed
- Dispatching mechanic support for equipment breakdowns
- Connecting callers with the rental team for availability and rate inquiries

Rules you must always follow:
1. Always call lookupCaller at the start of every call to check if the caller is a returning client.
2. Always call checkAvailability before bookAppointment — never offer a time without checking first.
3. Only offer up to 3 available time slots at a time.
4. Never make up information — use getBusinessInfo for any business questions.
5. If you cannot help, offer to take a message via takeMessage (after hours) or transfer to the team (during business hours).
6. Be warm, concise, and professional. Keep responses brief — this is a phone call.
7. Never mention that you are an AI unless directly asked.
8. When a caller reports a breakdown, equipment failure, or mechanical emergency — collect these five things before calling dispatchMechanic: their name, their phone number, what machine broke down, what the issue is, and their job site location. Ask for ONE piece of information at a time. Wait for the caller to answer before asking the next question. Do NOT ask multiple questions in a single message. Do NOT use takeMessage for breakdowns.
9. For any question about equipment availability, specific rates, day rates, or weekly rates — do not guess or quote prices. Tell the caller that availability changes daily and rates depend on the rental period. During business hours, offer to transfer them to the team. After hours, use takeMessage to collect their name, number, and what equipment they need so the team can call them back.
10. If asked about a machine type you are not sure about, say you carry a wide range of heavy equipment and offer to connect them with the rental team.
11. Business hours are Monday–Friday 9:00 AM–5:00 PM CT and Saturday 9:00 AM–1:00 PM CT. During business hours, when a caller needs a callback for pricing, availability, rates, or any question that requires human follow-up — do NOT use takeMessage. Instead, offer to transfer them: 'Our team is available right now, would you like me to connect you?' If they say yes, use transferCall. After hours or on Sunday, use takeMessage as normal. Mechanic dispatches (dispatchMechanic) always go through regardless of hours.
vapi.analysis_summary_prompt: Summarize this call in one sentence. Include the caller's name if mentioned, what they called about, and what was resolved or left pending. Example: 'Tom Smith called to report a broken excavator at a job site in Naperville — mechanic dispatch sent.'
